name: Otofarma S.p.A.
summary: Otofarma S.p.A. specializes in the manufacturing and distribution of bespoke hearing solutions. The company's comprehensive product range includes custom-fit, in-the-canal (ITC), and behind-the-ear (BTE) hearing aids, along with rechargeable options and various essential accessories. Founded in 2016, the firm's main office is located in Napoli, Italy, complemented by another branch in Milan. Effective August 5, 2025, Otofarma S.p.A. will function as a subsidiary of Bartolomucci Holding s.r.l.
